questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: USA scored 100 goals and Australia scored 53 goals at the Summer Olympics. How many more goals did USA score than Australia?

questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: Here are four teams and their goals — Japan: 58, Great Britain: 65, France: 64, Australia: 53. Which team scored the fewest goals?
questions.sourceFact: teamStats: Japan goals=58, Great Britain goals=65, France goals=64, Australia goals=53
questions.explanation: Compare the four numbers: 53 is the smallest, so Australia scored the fewest goals.

questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: USA had 100 match results recorded. They won 40 of those matches. What percentage of their matches did they win?
questions.explanation: Divide wins by total results, then multiply by 100: 40 ÷ 100 × 100 = 40%.

questions.subject: geography
questions.prompt: France competed at the Summer Olympics. What language do most people in France speak?
questions.explanation: French is the main language of France — the country's own name gives a big clue!

questions.subject: geography
questions.prompt: Australia sent athletes to the Summer Olympics. Which continent is Australia on?
questions.explanation: Australia is on the continent of Oceania, in the Southern Hemisphere.

questions.subject: geography
questions.prompt: Many people think Sydney is the capital of Australia — but it isn't! What is Australia's real capital city?
questions.explanation: Canberra is Australia's capital. It was specially built as the capital because Sydney and Melbourne both wanted to be chosen!
